changes_made.explanation: The paper uses LLMs for text summarization and generation as part of a trading system, but does not evaluate the NLG quality. It evaluates trading performance, not the generated text quality. Therefore, it does not address NLG tasks in the evaluation context.
The metrics listed (Return, Sharpe Ratio, etc.) are financial trading metrics, not NLG evaluation metrics. The paper does not use any automatic metrics to evaluate the quality of generated text.
No LLMs are used as judges to evaluate generated outputs. LLMs are used for generation within the trading system, but not for evaluation.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted. The evaluation is purely based on financial performance metrics.

overall_notes: This paper is about cryptocurrency trading using LLMs, not about NLG evaluation. While LLMs generate text (summaries, reports, trading rationales), the paper evaluates trading performance (financial returns) rather than the quality of the generated text. Therefore, it does not belong in an NLG evaluation survey. The original extraction incorrectly identified this as an NLG evaluation paper.
